correctness.rationale: Self-contained proof: facet-cover bijection; quotient acyclicity criterion; complete attached/disjoint two-edge case analysis; exact outward-normal dot products. Every pair independently checked by vertex-rank calculations for 5,230 naturally labelled posets through size six and 400 reproducible size-seven/eight samples, including all four counts. Tests are finite, not infinite proof.

evidence: Pegel characterizes all faces of marked order polyhedra by connected compatible partitions and gives the cover-facet correspondence for regular marked posets.
Ahmad–Fourier–Joswig proves injection between face sets in a maximal-ranked-poset chain-order family, but not Euclidean angles.
Freij-Hollanti–Lundström establishes face-vector inequalities for poset constructions; it does not provide the pairwise metric formula.
broader_coverage.reasoning: An arbitrary face enumeration via compatible partitions has broader object coverage and can imply any incidence answer after additional analysis. However the explicit all-poset pairwise forbidden patterns and four-angle aggregate law require the two-edge collapse classification and Euclidean dot-product computation. The risk of being judged a routine consequence is not eliminated.

originality.rationale: Prior general face-partition machinery (Stanley, Pegel, and Ahmad–Fourier–Joswig) is credited. The claimed contribution is the explicit exhaustive two-obstruction criterion for every pair of facets, plus four exact Euclidean angle counts across all posets. The compared accessible works encode faces or compare face numbers, rather than state these local obstructions and Euclidean multiplicities. A formerly derived rooted-tree spectrum is subsumed. The general partition theorem permits retrospective derivation and thus remains a genuine originality risk.
residual_risks: Pegel/Geissinger/Stanley general partition frameworks may permit an unindexed immediate equivalent derivation; no claim of historical priority certification.
Search indexes and full-text parsing may omit relevant statements outside inspected sections or under other terms.

value.rationale: A complete all-poset Euclidean codimension-two invariant with an explicit closed ridge-count law. Two distinct non-ridge obstructions isolate the precise failure of naive facet pair adjacency; crossed covers appear already in a four-element K_{2,2} poset. The formula yields angle multiplicities and a simple complete-two-level asymptotic law without enumerating polytope faces; this is not just a renamed parameter or arbitrary finite table.
